Poonam Wagh

Digital and integrated marketing

I build desire for premium and luxury brands, and turn it into discovery, footfall and loyalty. For more than five years I have worked across premium retail, e-commerce and consumer brands, from planning media for Procter & Gamble at Publicis Media Starcom to leading digital marketing for Phoenix Mall of the Millennium in Pune, a 350+ brand ecosystem that includes Zara, UNIQLO, Breitling, Rado and Longines.

My work spans media strategy, paid performance, e-commerce and e-merchandising, influencer and celebrity campaigns, CRM and experiential events, with up to ₹2 Cr in annual marketing investment and campaigns reaching 150M+ people.

Luxury and experiential

Luxury watch evenings

Breitling, Seiko, Rado and Longines

Private horology programs for watch connoisseurs and top CXOs at Phoenix Mall of the Millennium. Luxury watch buyers respond to access and expertise, not discounts. Intimate evenings built loyalty with high-value communities and lifted sales. Curated exclusive programs for Redbar Pune, luxury car and bike owners, Time and Tide and top CXOs, including horology evenings and the Breitling SuperOcean experience.

42% Like-for-like growth. 4 Watch maisons.

Beauty Xperience festival

Phoenix Mall of the Millennium

Pune's first and biggest beauty festival. Turned the mall into a beauty destination, bringing new communities in store and lifting category sales. Hosted 5+ high-impact events and tie-ups with Korean women's groups, hyperlocal communities, makeup studios and premium colleges and universities.

35% Like-for-like growth. 5+ Events.

Influencer and content

Celebrity and influencer marketing

Fashion, beauty, lifestyle and luxury

Creator and celebrity partnerships that travel across communities. Influence is how premium brands earn attention today. A managed creator ecosystem gave every launch reach and credibility at low cost. Creator partnerships across Breitling, Zara, Diesel, Mango, Victoria's Secret and Armani Exchange, with celebrity-led moments around launches and seasons.

350+ Influencers. 150M+ Reach. 75% Barter-led.

Content strategy

Phoenix Mall of the Millennium

AI-led, 3D and moment-marketing content built to be shared. Shareable content keeps a 350+ brand destination top of mind between visits and gives brand partners more visibility. A diversified strategy using AI-led content, 3D creatives, grid aesthetics, moment marketing, viral formats and breakout clips, with positioning shoots featuring celebrities and A-list influencers.

40–60% Engagement uplift. Top 5 X trending.

Commerce and loyalty

E-commerce and merchandising

Phoenix Mall of the Millennium

A digital-to-physical commerce journey across 350+ brands. Shoppers discover online and buy in store. Connecting the two journeys turns digital attention into footfall and sales. Seasonal edits, luxury and beauty stories, gift cards and fashion favourites, supported by website, SEO and e-merchandising, with 700+ non-branded keywords in Google's top 10.

700+ Top-10 keywords. +10% Organic traffic.

Club Phoenix

Loyalty transformation

Loyalty reimagined as a premium digital membership. Luxury shoppers expect recognition and service. A membership ecosystem makes every visit more seamless, rewarding and personal. From a transaction-led loyalty app to an experience-led membership: tiered privileges and recognition, AI-powered assistance, personalised discovery and one connected ecosystem.

3 Pillars: discover, assist, belong. 65+ CRM campaigns.
